roadmap.title: Chronological co-op story run
roadmap.description: Play the seven-chapter campaign with a co-op partner, activate every purple-tambourine minigame and complete each optional interaction when its section appears. Nothing is permanently missable because Chapter Select remains available for cleanup.

achievements.description: You did it! CO-LLA-BO-RATION!
achievements.sortReason: Automatic after the final story cutscene.
achievements.summary: Finish the full seven-chapter co-op story and watch the final cutscene.

guide.context: This is the campaign’s only automatic story achievement; every other achievement comes from optional activities or minigame discoveries.

steps.text: Complete every chapter with your co-op partner, then continue through the ending until the final cutscene finishes and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: All minigames found!
achievements.sortReason: Unlocks after finding the 25th minigame near the end of the Attic.
achievements.summary: Discover all 25 minigames hidden across the seven story chapters.

guide.context: A minigame registers as soon as its name appears on screen, so playing or winning it is unnecessary. Purple floating tambourines mark the locations, while Chapter Select and the Minigames menu show which entries remain missing. Chapter Select keeps every location available after the story.

collectibles.name: Whack-a-Cody
collectibles.method: Continue beyond Dr. Hakim’s minigame introduction in the sawdust room; @item{Whack-a-Cody} appears automatically after the cutscene.

collectibles.name: Flip the Switch
collectibles.method: Take the right-hand side route before jumping toward the button labeled @item{DANGER Moving Parts, Use Caution}; @item{Flip the Switch} waits at the path’s end.

collectibles.name: Tug of War
collectibles.method: After Cody fills the furnaces with goo and May detonates them, enter the cave and approach @item{Tug of War} beside the floating tambourine on the left; a white football sits on the right.

collectibles.name: Plunger Dunger
collectibles.method: Finish the blue-catfish ride and its following cutscene, then approach @item{Plunger Dunger} directly ahead of the spawn point.

collectibles.name: Tank Brothers
collectibles.method: At the section start, climb the first stack of pillows before passing the purple star lamp to find @item{Tank Brothers} on top.

collectibles.name: Space Walk
collectibles.method: Rise inside the space elevator toward the first level of three portals, stop just below that level, and enter the hidden wall teleporter leading to @item{Space Walk}.

collectibles.name: Laser Tennis
collectibles.method: After clearing the first three portals, ride the elevator toward the second portal level and enter the next hidden wall teleporter just below it to reach @item{Laser Tennis}.

collectibles.name: Rodeo
collectibles.method: From the section start, walk straight to the far end instead of taking the story path on the right, then climb the pillows to @item{Rodeo}.

collectibles.name: Feed the Reptile
collectibles.method: Finish the first rail ride with animal-picture obstacles, turn right immediately afterward, and find @item{Feed the Reptile} before using the yellow bounce pads.

collectibles.name: Batting Team
collectibles.method: Continue along the mandatory story route and approach @item{Batting Team} beside the piggy bank; the path passes directly through this minigame.

collectibles.name: Birdstar
collectibles.method: Walk to the far end of the opening castle courtyard and approach the television on the left to register @item{Birdstar}.

collectibles.name: Horse Derby
collectibles.method: Cross the outdoor town square to the funfair on the far right and approach the two interactive horses to register @item{Horse Derby}.

collectibles.name: Bomb Run
collectibles.method: From @item{Horse Derby}, move directly left onto the nearby funfair rooftops beside the Helltower area to find @item{Bomb Run}.

collectibles.name: Icicle Throwing
collectibles.method: Activate the left objective bell tower, then approach @item{Icicle Throwing} at that tower after the activity becomes available.

collectibles.name: Shuffle Board
collectibles.method: Activate the middle objective bell tower, enter its cave through the @item{Shuffle Board} neon sign, and approach the minigame inside.

collectibles.name: Snow Warfare
collectibles.method: Activate the right objective bell tower, enter its cave through the @item{Snowball Arena} neon sign, and approach @item{Snow Warfare} inside.

collectibles.name: Ice Race
collectibles.method: Leave the underwater station, swim to the surface, and approach the race start on the wooden platforms to register @item{Ice Race}.

collectibles.name: Garden Swings
collectibles.method: At the section start, climb the stones on the right and drop toward the garden swing below to find @item{Garden Swings}.

collectibles.name: Larva Basket
collectibles.method: After May waters the first plant, use the left-hand bouncy mushrooms to climb the rocks and approach @item{Larva Basket} at the top.

collectibles.name: Snail Race
collectibles.method: After dismounting the frogs, cross the platforms raised by May and crawl through the short tunnel; turn right around the large lantern to find @item{Snail Race}.

collectibles.name: Slotcars
collectibles.method: Walk straight to the far end of the starting area and approach the race track on the floor to register @item{Slotcars}.

collectibles.name: Chess
collectibles.method: Complete Rehearsal and return to the hub, then follow the ground-floor story route past @item{Chess} in front of the Symphony entrance.

collectibles.name: Musical Chairs
collectibles.method: From @item{Chess}, climb the books on the left, bounce from the drum, and swing across the hooks to @item{Musical Chairs} beside the blue radio.

collectibles.name: Volleyball
collectibles.method: When both players first receive jetpacks in the white-cloud area, descend to the cloud beneath the starting platform and approach the @item{Volleyball} court.

collectibles.name: Track Runner
collectibles.method: Complete Symphony and return to the hub, then enter the arcade immediately right of the newly opened objective entrance and approach @item{Track Runner}.

achievements.description: It takes two to… torture.
achievements.sortReason: First optional achievement in chronological story order.
achievements.summary: Press the red Start button beside the eight-latch platform in The Tree — Captured before destroying the latches.

guide.context: The torture-chamber interaction grants credit to both players at once. Chapter Select can restore the Captured section if the detour was skipped during the story.

steps.text: In @loc{The Tree — Captured}, reach the circular platform with eight red latches that Cody must cover in explosive goo.
Before May detonates the eight latches, follow the side path on the right and press the red @item{Start} button despite the warning.
Wait for the opened torture chamber to pull one player inside and trigger the achievement.

achievements.description: Self-inflicted paparazzi.
achievements.sortReason: Available immediately after the Mortar Wasp fight.
achievements.summary: Have one player photograph the other on the squirrel-and-tree stage after the Mortar Wasp fight in The Tree — Deeply Rooted.

guide.context: Only the player standing in the photograph receives credit, so partners who both want the achievement must exchange positions and take a second picture.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Mortar Wasp} in @loc{The Tree — Deeply Rooted}, then enter the camera room immediately afterward.
Place the player seeking the achievement on the stage with the squirrel-and-tree backdrop.
Have the other player operate the camera and take a photograph of the player on the stage.

achievements.description: Free the two plastic prisoners hidden in Rose’s Room.
achievements.sortReason: Near the start of Pillow Fort, after the Tank Brothers minigame.
achievements.summary: Ground-slam both figurine buttons simultaneously at the plastic prison beside the flashlight in Rose’s Room — Pillow Fort.

guide.context: This trigger requires both players to act together and awards both players credit in the same activation.

steps.text: In @loc{Rose’s Room — Pillow Fort}, pass the purple star lamp and continue to the large flashlight.
Climb the pillows to the flashlight’s right and enter the plastic prison containing two figurines.
Position one player at each figurine and ground-slam both front buttons at the same time; the figurines speak when the trigger succeeds.

achievements.description: The truth was out there all along!
achievements.sortReason: Complete at the pillow-tower antenna inside the yellow portal.
achievements.summary: Tune and finish all four audio frequencies at the yellow portal’s pillow-tower antenna in Rose’s Room — Spaced Out.

guide.context: Each signal counts only after its audio clip finishes. One player can complete all four scans, and the achievement then unlocks for both partners.

steps.text: In @loc{Rose’s Room — Spaced Out}, enter the yellow portal and use the first yellow bounce pad on the right.
Climb to the top of the pillow tower and interact with the antenna.
Rotate the antenna until each of the four distinct frequencies locks in, and remain on every signal until its full audio clip ends.

achievements.description: Shoot for the stars, literally.
achievements.sortReason: Use the seesaw in the same yellow-portal world after Faraway Frequencies.
achievements.summary: Use the yellow portal’s blue seesaw in Rose’s Room — Spaced Out to launch minimum-size Cody into the stars.

guide.context: The roles are fixed because only Cody can shrink, but one successful launch grants the achievement to both players.

steps.text: Enter the yellow portal in @loc{Rose’s Room — Spaced Out} and find the blue seesaw ramp near the start.
Have Cody shrink to his smallest size and stand on the seesaw’s lower end while May climbs above the upper end.
Have May jump down and ground-slam the upper end so the seesaw launches tiny Cody into the stars.

achievements.description: Guess it was time to cash out.
achievements.sortReason: The piggy bank appears after A Daring Devil beside Batting Team.
achievements.summary: Insert all four gold coins into the Hopscotch piggy bank, then jump on its exposed belly to break it.

guide.context: The player who breaks the bank receives credit. If both partners need the achievement, restart the checkpoint after the first unlock and let the other player perform the final jump.

steps.text: In @loc{Rose’s Room — Hopscotch}, find the piggy bank to the left of the mandatory @item{Batting Team} minigame.
Collect all four gold coins near the pig, then drop each coin into the slot on its back.
After the filled pig rolls onto its back, have the player seeking credit jump onto the exposed belly to smash the bank.

achievements.description: Put on a show and die trying.
achievements.sortReason: Available at the very start of Hopscotch, before Break the Bank.
achievements.summary: Launch the Hopscotch toy car through the ring above its red ramp by pulling the car back about halfway.

guide.context: A full-strength pull usually sends the car over the ring. Achievement credit can favor the rider, so exchange roles and repeat the jump if only one partner unlocks it.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Rose’s Room — Hopscotch}, walk straight to the far end instead of following the story path on the right.
Have one player enter the toy car while the other grabs its rear, aims it at the red ramp, and pulls it back approximately halfway.
Release the car and make the vehicle pass through the suspended ring above the ramp.

achievements.description: Now look who's extinct!
achievements.sortReason: Optional action at the first raised platform in Dino Land.
achievements.summary: Use the large dinosaur to eat the player riding the smaller dinosaur just after raising Dino Land’s first platform.

guide.context: The eating prompt appears only at the first raised-platform setup, so position the smaller dinosaur before advancing. One successful bite grants credit to both players.

steps.text: In @loc{Rose’s Room — Dino Land}, have one player control the large dinosaur while the other mounts the smaller dinosaur.
Use the large dinosaur to raise the first platform and place the smaller dinosaur just beyond that platform.
Align the large dinosaur’s head when the action prompt appears, then activate the prompt to eat the other player.

achievements.description: Isn't it pretty? That's going on the fridge.
achievements.sortReason: The printer is along the courtyard route after the train tracks.
achievements.summary: Jump into the rear rollers of the paint-area printer in Rose’s Room — Once Upon a Time and emerge as an art print.

guide.context: Printer credit is individual. Each partner must enter the rollers with their own character if both players want the achievement.

steps.text: From the start of @loc{Rose’s Room — Once Upon a Time}, cross the castle courtyard and take the path on the right.
Follow the right-hand path to the printer beside the paint area.
Have the player seeking credit jump into the rollers at the printer’s rear and wait until the machine flattens the character into an art print.

achievements.description: Choo Choo!
achievements.sortReason: Board the train at the opening courtyard before visiting the printer.
achievements.summary: Board the moving train from the courtyard tracks in Rose’s Room — Once Upon a Time.

guide.context: Boarding credit is individual, so each partner must use the train’s prompt with their own character.

steps.text: From the start of @loc{Rose’s Room — Once Upon a Time}, walk straight to the far end of the castle courtyard and locate the train tracks.
Stand beside the tracks until the moving train reaches your position.
Use the boarding prompt as the train passes and remain aboard until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Helltower? More like hello-from-up-here-tower!
achievements.sortReason: Climb Helltower while visiting the Gates of Time funfair.
achievements.summary: Raise Helltower at the Gates of Time funfair and climb all the way to its top.

guide.context: Falling resets the entire climb. Each player needs to reach the top separately for individual credit; May can leave a clone partway up to reduce the distance lost after a mistake.

steps.text: In @loc{Cuckoo Clock — Gates of Time}, find the lit @item{HELLTOWER} sign at the town-square funfair and have both players stand on the two front buttons simultaneously.
Climb the moving lower platforms carefully, using double jumps and air dashes to catch platform edges when necessary.

At the two moving side walls, wall-jump once, stop pressing movement while the character holds the wall, wait for the walls to move close together, and jump to the opposite wall; repeat this cycle until above the walls.
Continue across the remaining moving platforms and stand on the top of Helltower to trigger the achievement.

achievements.description: Enter the hidden house reached by boat in Cuckoo Clock.
achievements.sortReason: Use the river boat after the Helltower and funfair activities.
achievements.summary: Ride the Gates of Time river boat with both players and enter the small house on the right bank.

guide.context: Entering the hidden house awards credit individually, so both characters should cross the doorway before leaving the area.

steps.text: In @loc{Cuckoo Clock — Gates of Time}, reach the outdoor town square, follow the river, and board the boat at the river’s end with both players.
Ride the boat forward along the river until a small house appears on the right bank.
Leave the boat and have the player seeking credit walk through the small house’s doorway.

achievements.description: Again? Keep track of your kids!
achievements.sortReason: Return all four baby turtles after activating the village towers.
achievements.summary: Use the Winter Village magnet powers to return all four red and blue baby turtles to their mother on the frozen lake.

guide.context: The baby turtles appear only after the three objective bell towers are activated. Returning all four grants credit to both players at once.

steps.text: In @loc{Snow Globe — Winter Village}, activate all three objective bell towers to spawn the baby turtles on the central frozen lake.
Go to the lake’s rear and locate the mother turtle with four empty nests in front of her.
Use the magnet powers to push the red baby behind the pavilion and the red baby directly in front of the mother into two empty nests.
Use the magnet powers to push the blue baby in front of the pavilion and the blue baby directly in front of the mother into the remaining nests.

achievements.description: Took things a bit too far, didn't you?
achievements.sortReason: The red swing is available after activating the left bell tower.
achievements.summary: Use the magnet powers to spin the occupied red swing beneath Winter Village’s left bell tower until the rider flies off.

guide.context: The left bell tower must be activated before this side of the village thaws. Throwing the rider grants credit to both players.

steps.text: In @loc{Snow Globe — Winter Village}, activate the left objective bell tower to thaw the left side of town.
Travel beneath that tower to the cliffside end of the village and locate the swing set with a rider on the red swing.
Use the magnet powers to rotate the occupied red swing faster and faster until the rider is thrown away.

achievements.description: Don't feed the animals! Or do, they're adorable.
achievements.sortReason: Use the harpoon boat after surfacing from the underwater station.
achievements.summary: Catch a fish with a harpoon from the boat beside Ice Race in Beneath the Ice, then feed the fish to a seal.

guide.context: Feeding credit is individual. Each partner should catch and feed a fish with their own character if both players need the achievement.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Snow Globe — Beneath the Ice}, descend through the water, follow the story into the underwater station, leave the station, and swim back to the surface.
Find the small boat beside the @item{Ice Race} minigame and operate one of its two harpoons.
Catch a fish with the harpoon, carry the fish to a nearby seal, and feed the fish to the seal.

achievements.description: Scurvy! Ye look smashing, captain!
achievements.sortReason: Visit the pirate ship in the same open area as Something Fishy.
achievements.summary: Open the chest behind the pirate ship’s steering wheel in Beneath the Ice and equip the pirate hat.

guide.context: Pirate-hat credit is individual, so each partner must open and use the chest with their own character.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Snow Globe — Beneath the Ice}, leave the underwater station and swim back to the surface.
Locate the large pirate ship in the open area and climb onto its deck.
Behind the ship’s steering wheel, open the treasure chest and use it to equip a pirate hat on the player seeking credit.

achievements.description: Release that tension at the root level.
achievements.sortReason: The spa lies directly after the Burrower boss fight.
achievements.summary: Sit in the greenhouse spa pool immediately after the Burrower boss fight in Garden — Green Fingers.

guide.context: Spa credit is individual. Both partners must sit in the pool separately if both players want the achievement.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Burrower} boss in @loc{Garden — Green Fingers} and continue into the greenhouse spa building on the story route.
Enter the spa pool and use the sitting position with the player seeking credit until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: You reached a higher state of mind. Or at least some peace and quiet.
achievements.sortReason: Meditate when the jetpacks first become available in Symphony.
achievements.summary: Sit on a meditation stool inside the large tambourine in Attic — Symphony’s first jetpack area.

guide.context: Meditation credit is individual. The tambourine contains two stools, allowing both partners to sit and obtain their own unlocks.

steps.text: In @loc{Attic — Symphony}, reach the outdoor white-cloud area where both players receive jetpacks for the first time.
Fly into the large tambourine positioned in front of the golden dome.
Have the player seeking credit sit on either meditation stool and remain seated until the achievement unlocks.
